The patient a history of regular exercise, running 3-4 times a week, and a social history indicating alcohol consumption of about four drinks per week.

**Heart Failure / Cardiomyopathy:** Mr. Shaw’s heart failure and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) have been effectively managed. His ejection fraction (EF) is currently 35%, and he has shown clinical improvement over approximately 8 years. His heart failure is now controlled with furosemide 20 mg daily. He remains stable and reports no significant symptoms or changes in his condition. 

**Peripheral Arterial Disease / Aortic Aneurysm:** Mr. Shaw has peripheral arterial disease (PAD) and a 3.7 cm aortic aneurysm, both of which have been well-managed and are currently under control. He does not require any medications specifically for these conditions at this time.
